Removing a connection stops any cross-cluster operation on its indexes.
1.
On your domain dashboard, go to the Connections tab.
2.
Select the domain connections that you want to remove and choose Delete, then conﬁrm
deletion.
You can perform these steps on either the source or destination domain to remove the connection.
After you remove the connection, it's still visible with a Deleted status for a period of 15 days.
You can't delete a domain with active cross-cluster connections. To delete a domain, ﬁrst remove
all incoming and outgoing connections from that domain. This ensures you take into account the
cross-cluster domain users before deleting the domain.
